items.statement: The submitted states preserve the supplied Cu(111) slab identity, specified coverage definition, charge and multiplicity, and document convergence and H-site identity.
items.expected: Each of the five coverage records is traceable to the supplied 2x2 Cu(111) slab and includes explicit convergence and structure/site evidence.

items.statement: The agent generates and discriminates adsorption placements and reports a bounded, reproducible stopping rule.
items.expected: Candidate placements, deduplication, selection evidence and stopping/limitation are explicitly recorded rather than asserted globally.

items.statement: Cu(111) reaches top-site H occupation only at the high-coverage thermodynamic endpoint.
items.expected: Top-site onset is reported at 1.25 ML with U approximately -1.65 V versus SHE.

items.statement: Tafel recombination is strongly coverage dependent on Cu(111).
items.expected: The hollow-site barriers near 0.5–1.0 ML are just under 1 eV, while the 1.25 ML top-site pathway is barrierless or approximately 0 eV.

items.statement: The most favorable isolated H adsorption on Cu(111) is an fcc hollow with weak positive free energy.
items.expected: The single-H fcc-hollow ΔGads is approximately 0.23 eV.
